title: ThunderSync: Lossless Acceleration of Agentic Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.05935v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Language models are moving beyond generating answers to pursuing long-horizon goals in interactive environments. Post-training these agents requires long, heterogeneous trajectories, and synchronous systems leave learner engines idle until rollout and verification finish. To squeeze out these pipeline bubbles, asynchronous training overlaps rollout and learning across updates, but comes at the cost of policy staleness. We introduce ThunderSync, which starts gradient computation as soon as all required inputs are fixed, without policy staleness. For group relative policy optimization (GRPO), ThunderSync computes each trajectory's score gradient as soon as the reward for that trajectory arrives, without waiting for the group. For on-policy distillation (OPD), it computes gradients for each completed agentic turn's teacher-scored actions while tool calls run in the sandbox. translated_title: ThunderSync：智能体强化学习的无损加速
translated_abstract: 语言模型正从单纯生成答案转向在交互环境中追求长期目标。对这些智能体进行后训练需要长且异构的轨迹，而同步系统会让学习引擎在 rollout 和验证完成之前处于闲置状态。为了消除这些流水线空泡，异步训练在更新之间重叠 rollout 与学习过程，但其代价是策略陈旧性（policy staleness）。我们提出 ThunderSync，它在所有必需输入确定后立即开始梯度计算，且不产生策略陈旧性。对于组相对策略优化（GRPO），ThunderSync 在每条轨迹的奖励一到达时即计算该轨迹的得分梯度，无需等待整个组完成。对于在线策略蒸馏（OPD），它在沙箱中运行工具调用的同时，为每个已完成的智能体轮次中由教师评分的动作计算梯度。我们证明了梯度流式计算能够产生与（原文截断处）……相同的 GRPO 结果。
tldr: ThunderSync 通过在所需输入就绪后立即流式计算梯度，在不引入策略陈旧性的前提下消除流水线空闲，实现对智能体强化学习的无损加速。
en_tdlr: ThunderSync achieves lossless acceleration of agentic reinforcement learning by streaming gradient computation as soon as the required inputs are fixed, eliminating pipeline bubbles without incurring policy staleness.
